final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_images FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.entrystat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_images) AS overall_avg_images FROM step1) SELECT step1.access_status, step1.avg_temperature, step1.avg_images, step1.avg_images - step2.overall_avg_images AS difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg_images IS NOT NULL
